items.title: Posts, comments, reactions, and sharing show display names only
items.precondition: A contained runtime has a post with comments, reactions, a shared post, and an authenticated viewer who can open the share dialog.
steps: At desktop width, inspect a regular post, a comment, the reaction dialog, a shared-post embed, and the share dialog preview/current-user row.
Repeat at a narrow mobile width.
Open profile links from each applicable avatar or display name.
items.expected: No inspected surface renders @username; display names and normal controls remain visible, responsive, and clickable; profile links resolve to the same target.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: product owner confirmed this full UI acceptance item passed in the local server.
items.notes: Confirmed with a share containing an original post and captioned reshare.

items.title: Friends, picker, inbox, and thread remove handles without breaking identity actions
items.precondition: The viewer has at least one mutual friend with a username and an existing conversation, including a peer whose presence can be observed.
steps: Inspect friend rows, the new-message picker/search result, inbox row, and open thread header at desktop and narrow mobile widths.
Search the picker by the friend's username and open a conversation.
Open the peer profile from the inbox avatar/thread header and verify normal navigation.
items.expected: No handle text is visible; no blank secondary line or action misalignment remains; username search and username-based conversation opening still work; profile routes and presence status remain correct.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: product owner confirmed this full UI acceptance item passed in the local server.
items.notes: Confirmed for friend, picker, inbox, and thread identity surfaces.

items.title: Profile header and navbar remove handles while retaining profile identity behavior
items.precondition: An authenticated account can view its own profile and another profile with a username.
steps: Inspect own and other profile headers at desktop and narrow mobile widths.
Open the navbar profile menu and navigate through its profile entry.
Use the profile copy-link control and verify the copied/opened URL still contains the username route segment.
items.expected: Visible headers/menu show display names without @username; actions remain aligned and accessible; existing profile navigation and shareable username URL behavior are unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: product owner confirmed this full UI acceptance item passed in the local server.
items.notes: Username inputs/edit settings remain intentionally outside this visual assertion.

items.title: Identity controls remain meaningfully labelled
items.precondition: The implemented UI is available in a contained runtime with browser accessibility inspection or a screen reader.
steps: Inspect post, shared-post, comment, reaction, friend, inbox, thread, navbar, and profile links/buttons after the handle removal.
Confirm each has a discernible display-name-based accessible name or meaningful visible text.
Tab through the affected surfaces and activate one profile link in each category.
items.expected: No control loses its accessible name or focus behavior; raw usernames are not announced solely because they were removed from visible UI.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: product owner confirmed this full accessibility acceptance item passed in the local server.
items.notes: No targeted aria-label adjustment was required.

items.title: Username data and lookup contracts remain intact
steps: Search frontend source for remaining username references and classify each as a protected route, API/type, lookup, input, or accessibility consumer.
Verify username-first /u paths in post, comment, reaction, friend, inbox, thread, and profile code remain present.
Verify friend search and openConversationWithUsername call sites remain present.
items.expected: All display-only @username renderers are removed; APIs, types, authentication, URL routing, profile copy/redirects, lookups, and message opening are unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: residual render search for @${…username}, @{…username}, and ` @${…username}` returned no matches. Protected username routes, ProfilePage fetch/redirect/copy-link behavior, friend matching, and openConversationWithUsername call sites remain present.
items.notes: Read-only source audit passed; do not use a broad username deletion.

items.title: Build, lint, and architecture checks
steps: Run impacted tests if present, then npm run typecheck, npm run build, and npm --prefix frontend run lint.
Run available convention checks without treating absent package scripts as a pass.
Fix execution-caused failures and record any pre-existing/environment failure with evidence.
items.expected: No execution-caused type, build, lint, or convention failure remains; every unavailable or waived check is documented.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: npm run typecheck and npm run build passed. npm --prefix frontend run lint exited 0 with six pre-existing warnings in MessageQuoteStrip.tsx, PostDetailPage.tsx, PostPhotoCommentsPage.tsx, AuthContext.tsx, and ThemeContext.tsx. No root test or convention-check script is configured.
items.notes: This visual-only task required no backend migrations or API changes. The production build emitted the existing Vite chunk-size advisory.
